book.title: Luka Iesu Keriso Hari Manoḡa Lukaꞌa Mirihiro

content: Ḡozoba Ḡahunone Hadiḡa
Iesuꞌa kuru neḡano maꞌora azaḡaniꞌa ḡahunone mauḡa zamaḡano zeḡe ḡahunone ufiꞌeteꞌe horoziro.
Ebu zahara ḡozobaḡa ꞌahoganiꞌa kopa hadiḡa komeꞌa aheu ufiroteꞌe zuni horoniro.
Ebu Iesuꞌa ziro, “Eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe, zahara ḡozobaḡa ꞌadaꞌa vaze niduꞌa ufeta vitize hadi boro ofeha.
Zeḡe niduꞌaꞌe hadize ḡehaḡa rehano, tahiḡa daꞌo ofeha. U ḡozoba ꞌadiꞌe zahara roḡaeḡa, rehano ane hadiḡa niduꞌa ebu ane ogomu hadiḡa niduꞌa ofeha.”
Kuru Neḡa Fahe Ḡuzuhiteꞌe moneo Ḡoeriro
Iesu tahiꞌa nuꞌa kuru neḡa horonadu aꞌe hadi manoḡa zu Badiꞌa haroteꞌe ḡahunoneḡa hina rohorohoniroteꞌe moneo niguniro. Rehano Iesuꞌa ziro,
“Izidi zaeꞌa horoneꞌeteꞌe ḡauḡa niduꞌaꞌe fahe ḡuzuhiteꞌe madaḡaniꞌa ariꞌuma. Eꞌe madaḡano hadini ꞌahoga hadi ꞌahoga rana mene radiꞌuma.”
Haḡai Nu Badeḡa zu Aduga
ꞌOugadu ze Iesu ḡadiniro, “Ihore vazeḡa, eꞌeguḡaniꞌa naniꞌa fureraꞌuma? Ebu eꞌeguḡaniꞌa nariga fureranateꞌe madaḡanoꞌe nagi haḡai nu badeḡaniꞌa ibite fureraꞌuma?”
Aniꞌa naenaeziro, “Vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa zae mene soꞌosoꞌozifine tohutohoꞌi. Vaze ḡehaḡaniꞌa eḡe niḡano aradu ꞌahige reꞌuma, 'Eꞌe Keriso,' ebu 'Madaḡa ꞌai haniteha!' Rehano ze ago hegotoꞌi.
Uti zu roteto hariḡa egoꞌidene, ago rihanoꞌi. Eꞌeguḡaniꞌa hube hune ibite fureraꞌuma, rehano mada ḡonagaꞌe zogone mene ariꞌuma.”
Ebu aniꞌa ziro, “Haba ꞌahoganiꞌa haba ꞌahoga teite utitiꞌuma, zu gavamani ꞌahoganiꞌa gavamani ꞌahoga teite utitiꞌuma.
Haba nunuo habaꞌa borofe hagariꞌuma, zagaꞌa hiaꞌuma zu ugi boroꞌa fureraꞌuma. Ebu adureonoꞌo riho ḡauḡa zu haḡai nu badeḡa boroboroꞌa fureraꞌuma.
Rehano eꞌeguḡaniꞌa ꞌizema fureranogano, vazevazeꞌa za oboze teadu sausauziꞌuma, ebu nu'onu'o neḡano zu ḡuꞌa neḡano ohoze tiꞌuma. Eḡe uꞌano, kini zu gavana azaḡa mazao zae tutuze onamiꞌuma.
Aꞌe zaeꞌa zeḡe mazao eḡe hari manoḡa rae fureniteꞌe madaḡa reꞌuma.
Eꞌanoꞌo zamaze rinedadu nougenouge zae bare biriteꞌe moneo zamaze ago ibite adudanoꞌi.
Mazaḡa eḡeꞌa ḡoere zu zamarone huhuzaḡa zenadu agireze ꞌahoganiꞌa zuni zae mene agatoziꞌuma ebu zae ḡoere mene hezahohaꞌuma.
Zae vize moze, negoze, nabudize zu zae vazeꞌa zuni za revoziniꞌuma, ebu zae boꞌaḡano nuꞌe runeo tuḡuziꞌuma.
Eḡe uꞌano vaze niduꞌa za heꞌeheꞌeziꞌuma.
Rehano iguze tiba zuni mene dauniꞌuma.
Zaeꞌa edau gigaraune, ḡabone hidiꞌuma.”
Ierusalema Habaꞌa Ruiniꞌuma
“Ierusalemaꞌe uti azaḡaniꞌa ganaḡeḡenoga horonoꞌidene, aꞌe Ierusalema ruiniteꞌe madaḡa ꞌai haniteha rae ederiꞌuma.
Eꞌe madaḡano Iudea habaꞌano radiuꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe maḡa ferau itoꞌi. Ierusalema zamaḡano radiuꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe ferau vaḡinoꞌi, ebu guniꞌa neḡano radiuꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe Ierusalema ago diuḡoꞌi.
Mazaḡa eꞌe madaḡaꞌe Buka Zaḡoḡano mirihiroteꞌe ḡoeꞌa niduꞌa hudanadu Ierusalema azaḡa aduga boro ziniteꞌe madaḡa reꞌuma.

Eꞌe madaḡano ahiꞌeta roḡaeḡa zu nune hina ene guraḡa ḡubuzeꞌeteꞌe roḡaeḡaꞌe feranoga mene idaḡa radu aduga boro hidiꞌuma! Raha ꞌahao aduga boro bagaḡaniꞌa fureraꞌuma, ebu Badiꞌa zama ḡugiꞌa vaze mazao fureraꞌuma.
Zeꞌe benisi hina zimi ruziꞌuma, ebu ḡuꞌa azaḡa teige oboze teadu ꞌavoꞌa habaꞌa nunu tutuze onamiꞌuma. Iuda mene azaḡaniꞌa Ierusalema ruinadu zuhiꞌaniꞌuma, onamo zeḡe madaꞌa hauḡiꞌuma.”
Iesuꞌa Ariteꞌe Madaḡa
“Ebu mada, bato zu buzuva ragano haḡai nu badeḡa horoniꞌuma. Raha ꞌada haba nunu azaḡaniꞌa davara zu saꞌu boroboro guguḡa uꞌano, rihau rudaꞌuma ebu zamazeꞌa ꞌadaꞌadiꞌuma.
Vazeꞌa nagini rahao ꞌada fureratitaꞌaꞌe edereꞌe ꞌahine, rihau rudanadu higau bauriꞌuma, mazaḡa adure gigiꞌaḡaniꞌa hagahagariꞌuma.
Eꞌe madaḡano ze Vaze Ubuganiꞌa gigiꞌaḡa boro zu agaḡa boro hune madu ḡoze hina areꞌeteꞌe horoniꞌuma.
ꞌAhiguḡaniꞌa ḡadahe fureranoꞌidene, iḡunadu dude ehamanoꞌi, mazaḡa Badiꞌaꞌa zae ḡaboziteꞌe madaḡa ꞌai haniteha.”
Figi Ireḡa Hari Idaidaḡa
Ebu Iesuꞌa hari ꞌahoga idane ziro, “Figi ireḡa zu ire nunu ḡianoꞌi.
Za zaeꞌa bare ire rouḡaniꞌa udufaꞌoga horoneꞌetene, irugu madaḡaniꞌa haniteha rae edereꞌohe.
Eꞌe teige, ꞌahiguḡaniꞌa fureranoga horonoꞌidene, Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe madaḡaniꞌa haniteha rae ederoꞌi.
Eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe, izidi egaꞌe mene hauḡiꞌuma, onamo ꞌahiguḡa niduꞌa fureraꞌuma.
Adure zu rahaꞌe hauḡiꞌuma, rehano eḡe ḡoereꞌe mene hune hauḡiꞌuma.”
Ruhibe Radoꞌi

“Zaꞌe ufeta reꞌoreꞌeteꞌe zu gageꞌeteꞌe ebu ḡaboneze zamare borofeꞌeteꞌe uꞌano, zamaze mene adudafine tohutohoꞌi. Ebu zaꞌe eḡeꞌa bare areꞌeteꞌe madaḡano mene zaguzagafine zae bare ḡiazoꞌi, mazaḡa eꞌe madaḡaꞌe ꞌahiri miniḡaniꞌa mani tabara ꞌahiriniꞌeteꞌe teigiꞌuma.
Eꞌe madaḡaniꞌa raha ꞌada vaze niduꞌa mazao fureraꞌuma.
Eꞌanoꞌo aduganiꞌa fureratiteꞌe madaḡano feranoga zu Vaze Ubuga zamao edanoga veize, mada niduꞌa kurauꞌenaꞌa tohutohe radoꞌi.”
Mada niduꞌa Iesuꞌe kuru neḡano ihozinu, u ohere niduꞌaꞌe vaḡinadu Olivi Maḡa rae huneꞌeteꞌe maḡano radiunu.
Ebu oherebau uzeuze vaze niduꞌa Iesu ḡoere abitoga veize kuru neḡa onamiro.
